verdict.rationale: The transparency note states Copilot can run code to do complex calculations and generate graphs, which covers the core of the story. Analyst and Copilot in Excel are described as analyzing raw or attached data, which suggests this works on the user's own data. However, this rests on a single brief line, and nothing shows code execution producing downloadable files. Missing for 10: evidence of downloadable file outputs, explicit confirmation that code runs on uploaded user data, detailed docs of the code-execution environment, independent or hands-on corroboration.
